House walkthrough

Hold the left pad to walk and the right pad to look around. Room jumps to the next room. Tap a surface to start a measurement and tap again to end it.
W A S Dwalk
Arrow keyslook around
Shiftrun
Spacejump
F, or Space twicefly, when you're outside (Space up, C down; you land on the ground or a roof, and flying stops when you go in)
Gjump to the next room
Lroom lights on or off
[ and ]move the sun an hour
Clickmeasuring tape: click a surface to start, click again to end
Esccancel the measurement you're making
Prender this view with real light (it slowly sharpens; moving goes back to the fast view)
Oshow the pipes through the walls: drains red (existing brown), vents pink, cold water blue, hot magenta
1 2 3extension
4 5 6main house: cheap 3BR, ideal 3BR, art room
7 8 9primary bedroom
Pick the extension, main house and primary bedroom separately with the menus at the top left. You stay where you are.
